days.focus: Focus. Train. Transform. Pectoral Power & Volume

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Arch lower back slightly, retract scapulae, lower bar under control to mid-chest, drive up explosively.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Set bench at 30 degrees. Keep elbows at 45 degrees, deep stretch at bottom and squeeze at peak.

exercises.name: Chest Fly
exercises.instructions: Slight bend in elbows. Bring arms together in a hugging motion, squeeze pecs hard at center.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.instructions: Lie perpendicular across bench. Lower dumbbell behind head with deep ribcage stretch, pull over to chest.

exercises.name: Push Ups
exercises.instructions: Maintain strong core plank. Lower chest to floor and push up with full range of motion.

days.focus: 3D Deltoid Mass, Overhead Power & Traps

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Brace glutes and abs, press bar in straight vertical path clearing chin, lock out overhead.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Lead with elbows, slight forward lean, pause at parallel for maximum delt tension.

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.instructions: Raise dumbbells to eye level with controlled tempo. Avoid swinging torso.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward at 45 degrees or use incline bench. Pull arms wide to isolate rear delts.

exercises.name: Shrugs
exercises.instructions: Elevate shoulders straight up towards ears, squeeze traps for 1 second, lower under control.

days.focus: Arm Thickness, Peak Hypertrophy & Forearms

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Keep elbows pinned to ribs. Curl barbell upward with strong contraction and controlled 3-second eccentric.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Supinate wrists as you curl upward to maximize bicep contraction at peak.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Palms facing each other throughout. Great for arm thickness and grip strength.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: Rest upper arms firmly against angled pad to eliminate momentum and isolate the bicep peak.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.instructions: Sit and brace elbow against inner thigh. Curl dumbbell smoothly with intense focus.

days.focus: Tricep Horseshoe, Lockout Power & Density

exercises.name: Close Grip Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Grip shoulder-width apart. Keep elbows tucked close to body while pressing to overload triceps.

exercises.name: Rope Push Down
exercises.instructions: Spread rope apart at bottom of motion. Lock out triceps hard for 1 second.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Ext.
exercises.instructions: Keep elbows high and stationary. Lower weight behind head for a deep long head stretch.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.instructions: Stay upright on parallel bars to emphasize triceps. Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Kick Back
exercises.instructions: Torso parallel to floor, upper arm parallel to torso. Extend forearm back and squeeze.

days.focus: V-Taper Lats, Mid-Back Thickness & Deadlift Power

exercises.name: Pull Ups
exercises.instructions: Dead hang at bottom, drive elbows down to ribs, pull chest up toward bar.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge at 45 degrees, pull bar towards belly button, pinch shoulder blades together tightly.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Pull bar smoothly down to upper chest while leaning back slightly. Control the ascent.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Sit upright with neutral spine. Pull attachment into lower abdomen and squeeze back.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Bar over midfoot, chest proud, brace core, drive through heels to full standing lockout.

days.focus: Quad Teardrop, Hamstring Sweep & Calf Power

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width, brace abdominal wall, descend below parallel, drive up through midfoot.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Position feet mid-platform. Lower sled with control without lifting pelvis, press without knee lockout.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Extend legs fully, hold peak contraction at top for 1 full second, lower with 3-second negative.

exercises.instructions: Lie flat on machine pad. Curl heels up toward glutes with strong hamstring squeeze.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Full stretch at bottom, explode up onto toes and hold at top for 2 seconds.

supplements.name: Whey Protein Isolate & Concentrate
supplements.tagline: Ultra-pure fast-absorbing protein delivering 25g protein and 5.5g BCAAs per scoop.
supplements.purpose: Supports rapid muscle protein synthesis (MPS), repairs micro-tears from heavy resistance training, and helps meet daily macronutrient goals cleanly.
supplements.commonUsage: 1 to 2 scoops (30g-60g) mixed with 250ml water, almond milk, or blended in oat smoothies.
supplements.timing: Post-workout within 45 minutes, or between meals as a high-protein anabolic bridge.
supplements.considerations: If lactose-sensitive, choose 100% Whey Isolate or Plant Pea-Rice blend for zero bloating.
supplements.safetyDisclaimer: Supplements complement whole foods. Drink plenty of water and consult your physician if you have kidney conditions.

supplements.name: Micronized Creatine Monohydrate (Creapure)
supplements.tagline: Gold standard 99.99% pure micronized creatine for explosive power and muscle volume.
supplements.purpose: Increases phosphocreatine cellular reserves to rapidly re-synthesize ATP during heavy lifting, boosting max strength, power output, and intracellular cell volumization.
supplements.commonUsage: 3 to 5 grams daily continuously. No mandatory loading phase needed.
supplements.timing: Daily with 300ml water, fruit juice, or your post-workout protein shake.
supplements.considerations: Draws intracellular water into muscle cells, boosting muscle fullness. Maintain hydration at 3.5L+ water daily.
supplements.safetyDisclaimer: One of the most scientifically studied sports supplements in history. Safe for long-term daily use.

supplements.name: C4 Explosive Pre-Workout & Beta-Alanine
supplements.tagline: High-intensity energy matrix with 200mg Caffeine, Beta-Alanine, and Nitric Oxide pump boosters.
supplements.purpose: Heightens mental focus, surges nitric oxide vasodilation for intense muscle pumps, and buffers lactic acid burn during high-rep sets.
supplements.commonUsage: 1 level scoop in 200-250ml chilled water 20 to 30 minutes prior to training.
supplements.timing: 20-30 minutes before workout. Avoid within 5 hours of bedtime.
supplements.considerations: Beta-Alanine may cause a harmless, transient tingling sensation (paresthesia). Start with half a scoop to assess tolerance.
supplements.safetyDisclaimer: Contains high caffeine. Not suitable for individuals sensitive to stimulants or with hypertension.

supplements.name: BCAAs 2:1:1 + Electrolytes Intra-Workout
supplements.tagline: 7g BCAAs with L-Glutamine and essential electrolyte matrix for sustained intra-set stamina.
supplements.purpose: Suppresses muscle catabolism during demanding training sessions, curbs central nervous system fatigue, and accelerates intra-workout recovery.
supplements.commonUsage: 1 scoop dissolved in 500-700ml cold water sipped continuously throughout your session.
supplements.timing: Sipped during training or before fasted morning cardio.
supplements.considerations: Delicious hydration booster. If daily protein target is already high, primary value is hydration and flavor.
supplements.safetyDisclaimer: Dietary supplement for athletes. Keep container sealed in a dry environment.

supplements.name: Triple Strength Omega-3 Fish Oil (EPA & DHA)
supplements.tagline: High-concentration molecularly distilled fish oil with 1,000mg active EPA & DHA per softgel.
supplements.purpose: Lubricates synovial joints, mitigates delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS), supports heart cardiovascular metrics, and enhances arterial elasticity.
supplements.commonUsage: 1 to 2 softgels daily with a meal containing dietary fats for maximum absorption.
supplements.considerations: Enteric coating prevents any fishy aftertaste or burps.
supplements.safetyDisclaimer: Consult your doctor if taking anticoagulant blood-thinning medications.

supplements.name: Fast&Up Reload Effervescent Electrolytes
supplements.tagline: Rapid cellular rehydration tabs packed with Sodium, Potassium, Magnesium, and Vitamin C.
supplements.purpose: Eliminates muscular cramps, restores intracellular electrolyte balance lost through heavy perspiration, and sustains blood plasma volume.
supplements.commonUsage: Drop 1 effervescent tablet into 500ml water, let dissolve for 60 seconds, and drink.
supplements.timing: During or directly following intense workout and cardio sessions.
supplements.considerations: Ideal for high-heat training sessions and endurance sports.
supplements.safetyDisclaimer: Store in a cool dry tube. Do not exceed 3 tablets in 24 hours.

supplements.name: MuscleTech Platinum Multi-Vitamin & Minerals
supplements.tagline: High-potency 20+ micronutrient matrix fortified with 865mg Amino Support & Herbal extracts.
supplements.purpose: Fills dietary micro-gaps, optimizes metabolic enzyme synthesis, boosts immune resistance, and supports thyroid hormone conversion.
supplements.commonUsage: 1 serving (2 caplets) once daily with your morning breakfast.
supplements.timing: With the first solid meal of the day.
supplements.considerations: Take with food to prevent zinc-induced mild nausea.
supplements.safetyDisclaimer: Do not exceed stated daily dose. Keep out of reach of children.

supplements.name: KSM-66 Organic Ashwagandha (5% Withanolides)
supplements.tagline: Full-spectrum root extract clinically proven to lower cortisol and optimize natural vitality.
supplements.purpose: Reduces circulating serum cortisol levels by up to 27%, promotes deep Stage 4 REM sleep, and increases natural free testosterone in strength athletes.
supplements.commonUsage: 1 capsule (600mg) with warm milk or dinner.
supplements.considerations: Take consistently for 4-6 weeks for full adaptogenic hormone modulation.
supplements.safetyDisclaimer: Consult a healthcare specialist if pregnant or on thyroid hormone medications.

supplements.name: ZMA Night Recovery (Zinc, Magnesium & B6)
supplements.tagline: Bioavailable Zinc L-Monomethionine & Magnesium Aspartate for muscle relaxation and restorative sleep.
supplements.purpose: Calms central nervous system overstimulation, relaxes tense muscles, promotes deeper sleep quality, and prevents zinc depletion caused by hard gym sessions.
supplements.commonUsage: 3 capsules for men (2 for women) on an empty stomach 30-60 minutes before bedtime.
supplements.timing: Before bedtime. Avoid taking with calcium/dairy products as calcium blocks zinc absorption.
supplements.considerations: Take away from dairy for optimal absorption.

supplements.name: Pintola All-Natural Peanut Butter (Crunchy / 100% Roasted Peanuts)
supplements.tagline: 100% roasted bold-grade runner peanuts with 30g pure plant protein and zero added sugar or hydrogenated oils.
supplements.purpose: Provides slow-digesting healthy monounsaturated fatty acids, dietary fiber, and plant protein to fuel prolonged workouts, support joint integrity, and sustain caloric surplus during clean bulking.
supplements.commonUsage: 32g (2 level tablespoons) spread onto wholegrain toast, stirred into warm morning oatmeal, or blended into post-workout banana protein shakes.
supplements.timing: Morning breakfast, pre-workout energy fuel (1 hour before), or before bedtime for overnight amino release.
supplements.considerations: Natural oil separation is normal for 100% natural nut butters with no emulsifiers. Stir thoroughly before use.
supplements.safetyDisclaimer: Contains peanuts. Not suitable for individuals with tree nut or peanut allergies.

supplements.name: MyFitness High Protein Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter
supplements.tagline: India's highest rated athlete chocolate peanut butter infused with Belgian dark cocoa and whey protein isolate.
supplements.purpose: Delivers 26g muscle-building protein per 100g with luxurious Belgian dark chocolate taste, eliminating sweet cravings while maintaining strict bodybuilding macronutrient ratios.
supplements.commonUsage: 32g (2 tablespoons) with high-fiber sliced apples, rice cakes, protein crepes, or directly by the spoon.
supplements.timing: Ideal healthy snack between meals or 45 minutes prior to heavy leg/back training sessions.
supplements.considerations: Crispy version contains brown rice crisps for an addictive crunch.
supplements.safetyDisclaimer: Contains dairy (whey isolate) and roasted peanuts. Keep in a cool, dry place.

supplements.name: MuscleBlaze High Protein Dark Chocolate Oats (with Probiotics)
supplements.tagline: 22g high-grade protein per serving with rolled oats, premium whey isolate, real dark cocoa, and gut-healthy probiotics.
supplements.purpose: Supercharges morning energy, provides sustained glycogen replenishment with slow-burning complex beta-glucan carbs, and accelerates post-sleep muscle recovery.
supplements.commonUsage: Cook 50g-75g in 200ml warm skim milk or water for 3 minutes on low heat, or prepare as overnight oats.
supplements.timing: Breakfast within 1 hour of waking, or 90 minutes pre-workout for continuous training stamina.
supplements.considerations: Fortified with LactoSpore probiotics to maximize protein absorption and prevent digestive distress.
supplements.safetyDisclaimer: Packed in a facility handling milk, nuts, and cereals.

supplements.name: Quaker 100% Wholegrain Rolled Oats
supplements.tagline: World's iconic 100% whole grain oats rich in beta-glucan soluble fiber to lower cholesterol and sustain stamina.
supplements.purpose: Serves as the ultimate clean carbohydrate backbone for bodybuilders and fitness enthusiasts, stabilizing blood glucose spikes and providing continuous steady-state insulin response.
supplements.commonUsage: Boil 60g in 250ml water/milk for 3 minutes. Top with whey protein, chia seeds, sliced berries, and peanut butter.
supplements.timing: Ideal morning foundation or 2 hours prior to endurance/weight training.
supplements.safetyDisclaimer: Store in an airtight container away from moisture.

supplements.name: MuscleBlaze High Protein Crunchy Dark Chocolate Muesli
supplements.tagline: Crunchy multigrain muesli loaded with 25g protein, 22% almonds and pumpkin seeds, and rich dark chocolate curls.
supplements.purpose: Delivers an instant high-protein, high-crunch breakfast or snack without cooking. Combines fast-acting whey crisps with slow-digesting oats, seeds, and healthy monounsaturated almond fats.
supplements.commonUsage: Pour 50g-60g into a bowl with chilled milk, Greek yogurt, or enjoy straight from the bag as high-protein trail mix.
supplements.timing: Quick breakfast on rush mornings, intra-day office protein boost, or post-workout crunch.
supplements.considerations: Contains natural cocoa and dried fruit sugars. Zero synthetic sweeteners.

supplements.name: Dymatize ISO 100 Hydrolyzed 100% Whey Isolate
supplements.tagline: World-renowned award-winning hydrolyzed whey isolate for lightning fast absorption and zero gastrointestinal bloat.
supplements.purpose: Hydrolyzed whey peptides bypass standard enzymatic breakdown, entering systemic circulation within 20 minutes to trigger maximal mTOR anabolic signaling post-workout.
supplements.commonUsage: 1 scoop (32g) dissolved effortlessly in 200ml cold water.
supplements.timing: Directly post-workout or first thing upon waking during strict cutting/contest preparation phases.
supplements.considerations: Virtually zero lactose. Perfect for athletes experiencing digestive sensitivity to regular whey concentrates.

supplements.name: MyProtein Impact Whey Protein & Flavdrops
supplements.tagline: Europe's #1 selling premium whey protein with 21g protein and 4.5g BCAAs sourced from British dairy cows.
supplements.purpose: High biological value (BV) protein providing complete amino acid profile to repair torn microfibrils, increase lean dry muscle mass, and prevent muscular breakdown.

stretches.name: Standing Hamstring & Calf Sweep
stretches.instructions: Extend one leg forward with heel on floor and toes pointed upward. Hinge at hips with straight back, gently sweeping arms down toward foot.

stretches.name: Deep Pigeon Pose (Glute Opener)
stretches.instructions: Bring one knee forward behind wrist with shin angled across mat. Slide opposite leg straight back. Sink hips down square to floor.

stretches.name: Doorway Pectoral Stretch
stretches.instructions: Place forearm against doorway jamb at 90-degree angle. Step through gently until feeling a stretch across chest and shoulder.

stretches.name: Cat-Cow Spinal Articulation
stretches.instructions: On hands and knees: inhale and arch back, looking upward (cow); exhale and round spine toward ceiling while tucking chin (cat).

stretches.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Lunge with Reach
stretches.instructions: Step one foot forward into lunge, lower back knee to ground. Tuck pelvis and squeeze glute of rear leg, raising arm on same side overhead.

stretches.name: Dead Hang from Pull-Up Bar
stretches.instructions: Grip pull-up bar with overhand grip and let body hang relaxed. Breathe deeply into abdomen allowing gravity to decompress vertebrae.
